plan.notes: Official four-year sample plan published in the UW-Parkside 2025-2026 catalog PDF for the Computer Science Major (BS). 'Computer Science Elective' slots = any course from the catalog's published elective major courses list; 'Computer Science Breadth' slots = the catalog's 9-10-credit breadth package requirement. The sample plan sums to 124 credits (32/31/30/31 by year) while the catalog's minimum total for the degree is 120; total_credits records the plan's exact sum of 124. Year-1 MATH 111/MATH 114 and ENGL 100 are developmental skills-requirement courses recorded as gened.
